# Life

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The full lifespan, the top temporal (time) horizon.

## Scope note

- Root of the Calendar subgraph via IN_LIFE: frames lifelong goals and identity-level context.
- An area that includes your entire lifespan.
